اذلعببن (form IVq)
# اِذْلَعْبَبْنَ (iḏlaʕbabna) /ið.laʕ.bab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# اِذْلَعْبِبْنَ (iḏlaʕbibna) /ið.laʕ.bib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
